calculation.description: Negative two-session cumulative return residual to the daily median return of the 15 tradable benchmark instruments; higher values favor assets that recently underperformed their cross-asset peer baseline, using only completed sessions.

validation.regime_notes: Pooled multi-horizon ICIR was positive in 2020-2022 (0.0860), 2023-2024 (0.1189), and 2025-2026 (0.1929); sparse coverage reflects the available synthetic cross-asset histories and requires conservative monitoring.

signal_provenance.date_alignment: exact intersection of close-derived returns and next-session returns
